verses.text: "Get up and shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD has risen on you!
Look, darkness covers the earth, and deep darkness covers the peoples. But the LORD rises on you, and his glory appears over you.
Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn.
Look up and see all around you! They are all gathering and coming to you. Your sons are coming from far away, and your daughters are being carried in arms.
Then you will see and shine with joy. Your heart will pound and overflow with joy, because the riches of the sea will be brought to you. The wealth of the nations will come to you.
Herds of camels will cover your land, young camels from Midian and Ephah. All the people of Sheba will come, bringing gold and frankincense and announcing the praises of the LORD.
All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered to you. The rams of Nebaioth will serve you. They will be accepted as offerings on my altar, and I will make my glorious house beautiful.
Who are these that fly along like clouds, like doves flying back to their nests?

Surely the islands are waiting for me. The ships of Tarshish lead the way, bringing your children from far away, with their silver and gold, to honor the name of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, for he has made you glorious.
Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you. Though I struck you in my anger, in my kindness I will show you mercy.
Your gates will always stand open. They will never be shut, day or night, so that people can bring you the wealth of the nations, with their kings leading the way.
For the nation or kingdom that will not serve you will be destroyed. Those nations will be completely ruined.
The glory of Lebanon will come to you, the cypress, the fir, and the pine together, to make my holy place beautiful. I will make the place where my feet rest glorious.

The children of those who treated you cruelly will come bowing before you. All who looked down on you will bow down at your feet. They will call you the City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
You were once left alone and hated, with no one traveling through you. But I will make you the everlasting pride and joy of all generations.
You will drink the milk of nations and be nursed at the breasts of kings. Then you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

Instead of bronze I will bring you gold. Instead of iron I will bring you silver. Instead of wood I will bring you bronze, and instead of stones, iron. I will make peace your governor and righteousness your ruler.
Violence will no longer be heard in your land, and there will be no ruin or destruction within your borders. You will call your walls Salvation and your gates Praise.
The sun will no longer be your light by day, and the moon will no longer shine on you. For the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.
Your sun will never set again, and your moon will no longer fade. For the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will end.
Then all your people will be righteous. They will own the land forever. They are the young plant I have planted, the work of my hands, to show my glory.
The smallest family will become a thousand people, and the least important group a strong nation. I am the LORD. When the time is right, I will make it happen quickly."
